newsitem.title: USA: American Management withdraws NASA bid.
newsitem.headline: American Management withdraws NASA bid.

text.p: American Management Systems Inc said on Thursday it has withdrawn from NASA's integrated financial management program procurement process, saying the federal agency's approach makes success virtually impossible to achieve.
The program is intended to provide the National Aeronautics and Space Administration with an agency-wide, integrated core financial management system using commercial software packages.
American Management said it had some problems with the original request for proposal, but NASA would not modify any of the technical or contractual requirements.
The company said the contract is to be awarded later this year.
American Management specializes in customizing financial systems based on reusable software for public and private-sector clients.
